# testing_oas_example (Resource)

OASExample Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform

  float32_request              = 1.1
  float32_request_and_response = 12.12
  float32_response             = 2.2
  float64_request              = 1.1
  float64_request_and_response = 12.12
  float64_response             = 2.2

  ]

    "two",

  list_string_response_item = [

  number_request              = 1.1
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_example.my_testing_oas_example
  id = "1234567890abcdef"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_example.my_testing_oas_example "1234567890abcdef"
```
